# Studio Operations workspace instructions

- Build the studio business operations product with Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and React.
- Keep the dashboard responsive and accessible, with the navy, indigo, and white operations visual language. Do not display the previous company name in user-facing app text.
- Use typed components and keep UI state local unless a backend is explicitly introduced.
- Treat names, bookings, invoices, financial figures, and production items currently shown as illustrative prototype data.
- Keep uploaded client/equipment photos in local browser storage for this prototype; do not treat browser storage as secure production media storage.
- Do not connect payments, WhatsApp, authentication, or file storage without approved integration requirements and credentials.
- Run `npm run lint` and `npm run build` after relevant changes.
